newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's POSCO buys chrome, moly and manganese.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's POSCO buys chrome, moly and manganese.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) said on Friday it had bought 680 tonnes of low-carbon ferrochrome, 102 tonnes of ferro-molybdenum and 102 tonnes of manganese, all of Chinese-origin through, tenders on December 13.
A POSCO official said the second best offer for ferrochrome was made by POSCO Asia at 85.5 U.S. cents a lb C&F. The official declined to give price details for the winner.
Delivery for the ferrochrome was set for February 10 (340 tonnes) and March 31 (340 tonnes) at southeastern Pusan port.

The official said the second best offer for 102 tonnes of Chinese ferro-molybdenum was made by South Korean trading house Dongbu Corp at $10.1 a kg C&F. Delivery was set for February 10 (51 tonnes) and March 10 (51 tonnes) at Pusan.
He said it had bought the ferro-molybdenum from a British company.

The second best offer for 102 tonnes of Chinese manganese (over 97 percent purity and lump type) was made by a Hongkong-based company Perfect Billion International at $1,495 a tonne C&F. Delivery was set for January 31 (51 tonnes) and March 15 (51 tonnes) at Pusan.
